titulo_video: THE DARK SECRET OF PROFESSOR HAN SIHYUN

locucoes.text: Joo Inhyuk's just chilling there, when suddenly he stops and looks back confused after hearing someone calling.
OH MY~?
He's totally lost about what's going on in that hallway, dude's completely frozen.
Then the Professor appears carrying several boxes, walking straight toward him.
YOU'RE THE TENANT FROM 511...
Look at Joo Inhyuk's face, the guy's in total shock, good lord.
The guy starts sweating cold while trying to process the situation, even stutters calling for the Professor.
The Professor stares at him with a fixed look that gives you the chills, imagine being in his place.
The focus goes entirely to her mouth opening into a smile, while our boy lets out a nervous 'oh my'.
Then the manhwa title appears on screen, as the atmosphere starts getting heavy for real.
In a room full of stacked cardboard boxes, the move is happening pretty chaotically.
Someone stirs a paper cup with a stick, making the vibe even stranger there.
SORRY...
The girl's there in the kitchen and comments something about the cup, kinda awkward.
Even the cup is paper..
The conversation continues at a tense pace, with the student and Professor exchanging words in a pretty heavy atmosphere.
She looks down while continuing to talk, trying to hide something, damn.
MR. INHYUK...
DOES THAT MEAN YOU HAVE NO LIBIDO?
Right after, she crosses her arms and stares at our boy, waiting for an answer about this delicate subject.
The girl holds the box with a questioning look, as if she's not understanding the situation at all.
She lets out a confused sigh, totally lost about what's happening there, while staring at the mysterious contents of that box.
Surprise takes over her, as she points to herself, trying to understand if all this confusion is really directed at her.
She keeps that serene look, holding the box firmly, but we know there's something behind it.
And wouldn't you know she cracks a light smile? The guy must be totally lost now.
Right after, her hand holds a picture frame, showing a really happy photo of a couple at the beach.
When they ask who's in the photo, the girl reacts instantly with a 'huh?', kinda surprised.
In the image you can see the couple smiling, so they ask if that man is her husband.
She gives a heavy sigh, seeming like the subject is pretty sensitive for her, what a situation.
YES, MY GUI. HE'S HANDSOME, ISN'T HE?
Joo Inhyuk takes a sip from the cup while agreeing the guy's handsome, but inside he must be freaking out.
The focus goes back to his face as he thinks that, apparently, she's married.
BUT NOW...
She continues the sentence while her hands rest on her knees, making the atmosphere heat up in a bizarre way.
NOT IN THIS WORLD ANYMORE.
Joo Inhyuk is shocked by the revelation, poor guy, he didn't expect her husband had already passed.
Surrounded by several boxes, our boy gets up to offer help, and the girl accepts right away.
C-CAN I HELP YOU A BIT?
She reacts surprised by the offer, seeming like she wasn't counting on that kindness.
I'D BE REALLY GRATEFUL.
The young man carrying everything warns there's still more stuff in the car, telling her to be careful.
Holding a giant pile of books, he glances at her like he wants some help.
The girl smiles in a totally suggestive way, running her hand across her face, damn, what's this?
The scene shows the building from outside, on a normal day, but we know inside it's heating up.
The focus goes to the balcony, where the mystery keeps growing, and the atmosphere gets stranger and stranger.
Joo Inhyuk enters the room carrying the weight of the books, poor thing, he's almost collapsing there.
He observes an empty table in the middle of the room, everything lit and silent.
...IT'S BIGGER THAN I IMAGINED.
IS IT BECAUSE SHE HASN'T FINISHED ORGANIZING?
Suddenly, he freezes completely noticing the object on the floor, eyes wide, trying to process that.
The guy finds a red diary with an 'L' on the floor and already wonders if it's hers.
He crouches down quickly to grab the diary, cause curiosity got the better of him, how dangerous.
Look at the size of his eye in close-up, dude found something he shouldn't have, good lord.
He takes a photo out of the book and his expression changes completely, RIP to the guy.
He keeps staring at the photo, trying to understand what that means, did he discover the secret?
His face shows the situation is way too tense, he's in real shock.
He continues fixed on that red object in a dark corner, while the tension rises big time.
The young man's holding a paper with a face like he saw a ghost, he's all red, damn.
The scene gets super intense, and Joo Inhyuk can't believe what's in front of him.
The atmosphere is so heavy that the silence becomes deafening, my god.
The guy enters total denial mode, cause he doesn't want to accept what he discovered.
NO...
NO WAY...
He starts having a flashback of the day he met her, and everything makes sense now, what a disaster.
THAT DAY...
When someone asks about the photos, he panics, good lord, run while you can.
Shows someone on the floor totally immobilized, the scene is too strong, for the love of god.
There's a visual impact effect, like his world just turned upside down.
The lamp stays on, illuminating our boy's despair in the silent room.
He looks at the book and says he can't believe that, as the penny finally drops, poor thing.
He stands there frozen, thinking about Professor Han Sihyun and what kind of person she really is.
THAT WOMAN... PROFESSOR HAN SIHYUN...
The guy's all flushed, remembering a bizarre fantasy and running his hand through his hair, what's this, man.
HAD A KINK LIKE THAT...
Suddenly someone enters apologizing, and the scare is so big he almost loses his heart.
The person reacts super surprised seeing his unexpected return there, making the atmosphere heavy again.
Y-YOU'RE BACK ALREADY?!
She's paralyzed, unable to formulate a single word, processing the impact of his presence that appeared out of nowhere.
The two start talking about the diary, with Noh Yeseul super curious to know what happened.
WHAT IS IT?
Joo Inhyuk's face is pure confusion, the guy's literally frozen.
The guy lets out a sound of bewilderment, completely stunned by her reaction, trying to decipher that silence.
He asks a question, but her silence is worse than any answer, such tension, man.
W-WHICH ONE ARE YOU TALKING ABOUT?
The figure just observes everything in absolute silence, keeping a firm posture while a heavy tension hangs in the air.
And wouldn't you know Noh Yeseul comes up behind him out of nowhere? What was that move, help.
YOU SAW IT, DIDN'T YOU?
She leans forward, staring at him real close, while the pressure goes through the roof.
Noh Yeseul gets close to him and our boy is visibly stunned, if I were him I'd have run already, man.
The scene gets abstract, you can hear the sound of their nervousness through the graphic effects, damn.
LIBIDO
The focus closes on the lips and the tension is at the limit, are they gonna cross the line? The problem is this is gonna cause one hell of a mess!
